artifacts.name: The Jeweler's Loupe
artifacts.effect: Rare and mythic cards sell at 85% of their market price, instead of 80%.
artifacts.flavor: Under the glass, every scratch has a price, and so has every gleam.

artifacts.name: The Amber Hourglass
artifacts.effect: While you are away, the collection earns for 12 hours instead of 8.
artifacts.flavor: Its sand runs slower when no one is watching.

artifacts.name: The Velvet Purse
artifacts.effect: The collection earns 25% more.
artifacts.flavor: Heavier every time you open it. No one knows why.

artifacts.name: The Merchant's Token
artifacts.effect: Every booster costs 5% less.
artifacts.flavor: Show it at the counter: the price comes down by itself.

artifacts.name: The Archivist's Seal
artifacts.effect: Boosters of sets released before 2000 cost 10% less.
artifacts.flavor: It opens the back room, where the old boxes wait.

artifacts.name: The Collector's Lectern
artifacts.effect: The collection earns 2% more for every set completed, up to 40%.
artifacts.flavor: A book laid open at the right page: the one with nothing missing.

artifacts.name: The Calligrapher's Quill
artifacts.effect: Tokens and art cards sell at their full market price.
artifacts.flavor: Every stroke it signs is worth its weight in ink.

artifacts.name: The Loaded Die… but Honest
artifacts.effect: A bet won pays 10% more. The odds stay fair.
artifacts.flavor: It never cheats. It just cheers.

artifacts.name: The Golden Horseshoe
artifacts.effect: Once a day, the stake of a bet lost is given back.
artifacts.flavor: Hang it points up, so the luck stays in.

artifacts.name: The Wanderer's Lantern
artifacts.effect: The daily help of the Boosterium is doubled.
artifacts.flavor: For those who came back with empty pockets, and came back anyway.

artifacts.name: The Coffer of Doubles
artifacts.effect: Selling duplicates pays 10% more.
artifacts.flavor: Two of a kind? One for the binder, one for the coffer.

artifacts.name: The Money Changer's Scales
artifacts.effect: Undoing a sale costs half the usual penalty.
artifacts.flavor: Second thoughts weigh less on these scales.

artifacts.name: The Speculator's Eye
artifacts.effect: Cards worth {cents:5000} or more sell at 85% of their market price.
artifacts.flavor: It sees the big pulls coming, and the buyers too.

artifacts.name: The Bronze Key
artifacts.effect: Collector boosters cost 10% less.
artifacts.flavor: The first of five. It opens the first drawer.

artifacts.name: The Silver Key
artifacts.effect: Collector boosters cost a further 10% less. Found only by the bearer of the Bronze Key.
artifacts.flavor: The second drawer was locked from the inside.

artifacts.name: The Gold Key
artifacts.effect: Collector boosters cost a further 10% less. Found only by the bearer of the Bronze and Silver Keys.
artifacts.flavor: Heavy, warm, and never quite where you left it.

artifacts.name: The Diamond Key
artifacts.effect: Collector boosters cost a further 10% less. Found only by the bearer of the Bronze, Silver and Gold Keys.
artifacts.flavor: It cuts the lock rather than turning it.

artifacts.name: The Obsidian Key
artifacts.effect: Collector boosters cost a further 10% less, half price with the five keys. Found only by the bearer of the four others.
artifacts.flavor: The last drawer holds nothing. The key was the treasure.

artifacts.name: The Cartographer's Compass
artifacts.effect: Draft boosters cost 5% less.
artifacts.flavor: Its needle points to the next table, where the packs are being passed.

artifacts.name: The Broken Seal
artifacts.effect: Selling duplicates pays a further 10% more.
artifacts.flavor: A thousand cards sold, and the wax still remembers each one.

artifacts.name: The Grimoire of Myths
artifacts.effect: Mythic cards sell at 90% of their market price.
artifacts.flavor: A hundred legends between its covers, and a buyer for every one.

artifacts.name: The Lapidary's Prism
artifacts.effect: Foil cards sell at 90% of their market price.
artifacts.flavor: It splits the light the way foils do, and doubles the shine.

artifacts.name: The Antiquarian's Monocle
artifacts.effect: Cards of sets released before 2000 sell at 90% of their market price.
artifacts.flavor: Through it, old cardboard looks like what it is: history.

artifacts.name: The Merchant's Master Key
artifacts.effect: Every booster costs a further 5% less. For sale to the bearer of the Merchant's Token.
artifacts.flavor: It opens every door of the shop, even the one to the stockroom.

artifacts.name: The Horn of Plenty
artifacts.effect: The collection earns 15% more.
artifacts.flavor: Tip it gently: Seals pour out, and never quite run dry.

artifacts.name: The Obsidian Clepsydra
artifacts.effect: While you are away, the collection earns for 24 hours. Given to the bearer of the Amber Hourglass.
artifacts.flavor: Black water, dripping one Seal at a time, all night long.

artifacts.name: The Shepherd's Star
artifacts.effect: The collection earns 1% more for every set completed, up to 30%, on top of the Lectern.
artifacts.flavor: It shines brighter over every binder that is full.

artifacts.name: The Four-Leaf Clover
artifacts.effect: A bet won pays 25% more. Found only by the bearer of the Honest Die.
artifacts.flavor: Pressed between two commons, it has brought luck to every pack since.

artifacts.name: The Dragon's Egg
artifacts.effect: The collection earns twice as much, every other bonus counted. Found in Collector boosters, only by the bearer of the five keys.
artifacts.flavor: Warm to the touch. Something inside is counting your cards.

artifacts.name: The Crown of the Counter
artifacts.effect: The collection earns 10% more, and your balance wears a golden frame.
artifacts.flavor: Every curio in its place, and the Counter has a new master.
